description: The figure is a pie chart intended to represent four categories related to the “Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge” benchmark, shown as a circle divided into 4 equal slices. The slices are labeled “Complexity” (gold/yellow, approximately 25%), “Instance” (blue-gray, approximately 25%), “Coverage” (green, approximately 25%), and “Scalable Oversight” (reddish/maroon, approximately 25%), with each label placed inside its slice along with a small icon. There is no separate legend and no numeric percentage labels displayed; the equal quadrant layout visually indicates equal proportions. No slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the slices are arranged as quadrants rather than in a descending-size order. Surrounding the pie are additional boxed words (“Uncrushable,” “Unhackable,” “Auto-verifiable,” and “General”), but these are outside the slices and not shown as part of the pie’s segmented proportions.
